title: Antonio Inoki vs. Tiger Jeet Singh
summary: Tiger Jeet Singh becomes one of Inoki’s defining early antagonists. Their hostile encounters move from a notorious street confrontation into a struggle for the NWF championship.

chapters.title: The department-store confrontation
chapters.result: Singh attacks Inoki outside the Isetan department store.
chapters.context: The public confrontation provides an early angle for a rivalry that becomes central to New Japan’s first years.

chapters.title: Singh wins the vacant NWF title
chapters.result: Singh defeats Inoki to become NWF champion.
chapters.context: The feud now carries the promotion’s leading championship, with Inoki forced to chase his antagonist.

chapters.title: Inoki takes the title back
chapters.result: Inoki defeats Singh two falls to one for the NWF title.
chapters.context: The title recovery supplies a major payoff without ending their later encounters. The date follows the contemporary event record.
